breakdown.description: The follower hole pressure is replaced by a dead load using the reference normal
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction. The ground truth specifies to use a "follower pressure" and explicitly rejects the "dead load" approach. The generated specification includes both contradictory instructions: it first correctly describes the follower pressure, but then adds the incorrect instruction from the original prompt, "Apply the hole load as a dead pressure using the reference normal of the undeformed hole boundary." This fails to fix the error.
